snippet.title: Pac-Man Lite - Uzebox Gameplay
snippet.description:
Pac-Man is a re-make of the 1980 classic arcade game. Every attempt was made to keep the Uzebox version faithful to the original. Pac-Man theme and intermission music converted by Uze. This is the "Lite" version, as the HEX file is too large to fit with bootloader, thus fitting in the 60Kbytes below it.

Developed by Paul McPhee
You can download the game here: https://uzebox.org/wiki/Pac-Man
